key_takeaways: AI 코딩 에이전트 마켓플레이스 내 플러그인의 구조적 특징과 의존성 관계 분석

en.title: On the Maintenance and Co-evolution of Agent Plugins: An Empirical Study of Claude Code Plugin Marketplaces
en.hook: An empirical study exploring the structure, maintenance challenges, and co-evolution of AI coding agent plugin ecosystems.
key_takeaways: Analyzes structural characteristics and dependency patterns in AI coding agent plugin marketplaces.
Investigates plugin compatibility and maintenance efforts driven by underlying agent framework updates.
Provides actionable software engineering insights for building sustainable AI agent ecosystems.

实证调查底层智能体框架更新对插件兼容性与维护工作的影响
为构建可持续的 AI 智能体生态系统提供软件工程方面的指导建议
